authorization.sampled_authorization_rule: A later commit may authorize exactly one sampled execution only if the separately committed structural record admits all four arms. A failed structural gate stops R4a without sampling and leaves QR5 undetermined.
authorization.temporal_order: This result-free declaration lands first; the structural producer, record, and regenerating checker belong to a later commit, and any sampled producer and record belong to a commit after the structural gate.

parent_lineage.base_commit_role: Phase G1 is complete, G2-G3 are retired, Track B is complete, and R4a is the only open numbered phase.

estimand.name: R4a_contextual_and_adaptive_compression_interaction
estimand.question: At one frozen BeH2/JW accuracy target and under one common cost protocol, is the joint contextual-subspace plus A-CASE gain complementary, multiplicative, redundant, or antagonistic relative to the two standalone gains?
estimand.structural_stage: Determine whether every one of the four fixed arms has a bias floor below the declared margin and a measured word universe at or below the inherited priceability ceiling before spending any shots.
estimand.sampled_stage_if_later_authorized: Estimate r_CS = C0/C_CS, r_A = C0/C_ACASE, r_joint = C0/C_CS+ACASE, and Delta = log(r_joint) - log(r_CS) - log(r_A), propagating the frozen shot-search uncertainty.
estimand.exclusions: The structural stage cannot price C(epsilon), report a cost ratio, classify QR5, select a device-wide winner, or alter the frozen Phase 14b and R3 findings.

system.label: linear BeH2 STO-3G CAS(4e,4o)
system.reference: the frozen Hartree-Fock determinant supplied by the committed FCIDUMP model
system.exact_reference: dense ground state in the frozen N=4, Sz=0 sector

candidate_family.name: complete symmetry-preserving determinant singles and doubles
candidate_family.basis_order: identity first, followed by the constructor's canonical occupied-virtual loop order

acase_bank.selection_rule: R3S margin rule: the smallest prefix of the frozen BeH2 greedy ordering whose exact subspace bias is at most accuracy_target_millihartree / margin_factor

arms.name: full_qse
arms.basis: identity plus the complete declared candidate family

arms.name: cs_qse
arms.basis: the complete declared candidate family transported through the selected contextual restriction

arms.name: acase
arms.basis: the frozen three-vector R3S BeH2 margin-stop bank

arms.name: cs_acase
arms.basis: the frozen three-vector R3S bank transported through the selected contextual restriction

matched_rules: all arms use the same FCIDUMP, Jordan-Wigner Hamiltonian, Hartree-Fock reference, exact sector energy, accuracy target, identity treatment, device cards, grouping grid, estimators, shot endpoints, and pass rule
the two QSE arms share the complete candidate family and the two A-CASE arms share the frozen R3S basis
the two contextual arms share one selected contextual rung and one compiled Restriction
annihilated or duplicate projected candidates remain reported and may not be silently replaced

future_classification.complementary: Delta is positive beyond propagated uncertainty
future_classification.multiplicative: Delta contains zero and the joint ratio is distinguishable from both standalone ratios
future_classification.redundant: the joint ratio is indistinguishable from max(r_CS, r_A)
future_classification.antagonistic: the joint ratio is below max(r_CS, r_A)
future_classification.undetermined: any required cost is structurally inadmissible or remains right-censored

contextual_restriction.scope: reference-conditioned commuting stabilizer subset; not a general implementation of every CS-VQE noncontextual-Hamiltonian heuristic
contextual_restriction.candidate_source: non-identity Pauli words appearing in the frozen Jordan-Wigner Hamiltonian
contextual_restriction.term_order: descending absolute real coefficient, then ascending packed Pauli-word code
contextual_restriction.sign_rule: the coefficient-minimising sign: -1 for a positive coefficient and +1 for a negative coefficient
contextual_restriction.reference_rule: admit only a word whose Hartree-Fock expectation is within tolerance of the coefficient-minimising sign; a non-extremal expectation or the opposite sign is rejected
contextual_restriction.commutation_rule: admit only words commuting with every earlier selected stabilizer
contextual_restriction.independence_rule: GF(2) symplectic rank must increase by exactly one
contextual_restriction.tableau_rule: compile the signed independent stabilizers in selected order to +Z on fixed qubits 0 through count-1; arbitrary completion acts only on the unfixed complement
contextual_restriction.projection_rule: the full Hamiltonian, reference, and candidate family move through one congruent rotation; Hamiltonian terms anticommuting with an artificial stabilizer are projected away and their fraction of the non-identity Hamiltonian Hilbert-Schmidt norm is mandatory structural output; the full Hamiltonian is projected unchanged, but its identity energy shift is excluded from this diagnostic denominator
contextual_restriction.exact_symmetry_boundary: Restriction.transport remains strict and is not weakened; only project_contextual_problem may project a Hamiltonian that breaks an artificial stabilizer
contextual_restriction.rung_rule: Select the largest fixed-qubit count for which every one of the four arms clears both structural gates. If no rung clears, stop without sampling.
contextual_restriction.citation: Weaving et al., A Stabilizer Framework for Contextual Subspace VQE and the Noncontextual Projection Ansatz, arXiv:2204.02150

structural_screen.hamiltonian_removed_hs_fraction_denomina: Hilbert-Schmidt norm of the non-identity Hamiltonian; identity energy shifts are excluded
structural_screen.grouping_rule: largest-conflict-degree greedy coloring under dyadic block commutativity
structural_screen.failure_rule: If any arm at every contextual rung fails either gate, the structural record stops R4a without sampling and records which gate failed. It does not label a screen rejection as infinite cost.
structural_screen.infinite_cost_rule: C(epsilon) may be labelled infinite only when an arm's exact bias floor exceeds epsilon; an operational word-universe rejection or a sampled right-censor is not infinite cost.

conditional_sampled_protocol.seed_derivation: numpy.SeedSequence(root, spawn_key=(arm_index, contextual_rung_index, block_size_index, replica_index)); roots and namespaces are disjoint
conditional_sampled_protocol.pass_rule: all 100 confirmatory solves succeed and the one-sided 95% bootstrap RMSE upper bound against the frozen exact sector energy is at most 1.6 mHa
conditional_sampled_protocol.crossing_rule: confirm the first exploratory passing endpoint and its predecessor; a finite interval requires a confirmed failing predecessor and confirmed passing endpoint
conditional_sampled_protocol.censoring_rule: a cell without a confirmed finite interval at 65536 is right-censored; it is not assigned infinite cost and does not license a wider grid
conditional_sampled_protocol.interaction_uncertainty: derive interval bounds for each ratio from its two finite cost brackets and combine the three log-ratio intervals conservatively; no midpoint-only QR5 classification

reporting_contract.scope: one BeH2/JW bank under the frozen constructor, structural screen, oracle exact-tier protocol, and illustrative device cards; no instance-independent contextual-subspace or A-CASE advantage

claim_boundary: This configuration contains no R4a contextual stabilizer selection, structural-screen result, selected contextual rung, bias floor, word universe, setting count, sample, cost bracket, ratio, Delta, or QR5 classification. A later structural record may report only the frozen BeH2/JW four-arm admission screen. Sampling remains unauthorized unless that record admits every arm under the declared bias and word-universe gates; any sampled execution, if authorized by a later commit, must preserve this bank, constructor, rung rule, measurement grid, estimators, endpoints, seeds, pass rule, and device cards.
